$comment: The repo Survey Definitions (GovernanceActionProcess + chained steps) that RE's Survey tab
lists and executes. Runs last (see ../_folder_order.json) because each document's 'Link
Element To Scope' commands bind the definition to Question terms by name: process this batch
while the questions batch is absent and every command still reports success, but no ScopedBy
link is created. The definition then looks perfectly healthy — its own canary is present —
while the scoped lookup that depends on those links silently returns nothing. That exact
state is what RE was in on 2026-08-19, and it is why order here is load-bearing rather than
cosmetic.
NOT IDEMPOTENT — the single most important fact about this batch. Dr.Egeria's 'Link First
Process Step' / 'Link Next Process Step' commands do not dedupe: re-running a document
against an already-linked process creates a SECOND edge for every step rather than merging.
SurveyDefinitionReader then sees two outgoing next-steps from one step, correctly refuses to
guess which chain is intended, and raises UnsupportedSurveyDefinitionError — taking the whole
Survey Definition out of service (renders as an errored card with zero steps). Confirmed live
twice: 2026-08-13 (the incident that motivated the reconciler) and again 2026-08-19, when
re-running all four documents produced 22 duplicate edges at once.
Two consequences the bootstrap MUST honour:
* Only heal this batch when its canary is MISSING. Never re-run it 'just in case', and
never as part of a blanket 'run everything' action without an explicit confirmation.
* After any heal of this batch, run the reconciler
(scripts/reconcile_survey_definition_links.py) to strip duplicates a heal may itself have
introduced — hence post_heal below. The reconciler needs pyegeria >= 6.0.18.4; on older
versions its deletes silently no-op (PYEGERIA_ISSUES.md ISSUE-63) and it will cheerfully
report removals that did not happen.
Canary is keyed on qualified_name: unlike glossary terms, these are author-controlled in the
document itself ('GovActionProcess::RepoFullSurvey'), so they carry no deployment-specific
org prefix or version and are safe to hard-code. RepoFullSurvey is the largest definition
(22 steps) and its process element is created after all of its steps, so its presence means
the document ran to completion rather than merely starting.
FILE LIST COMPLETENESS (fixed 2026-08-20): this list must name every document the generator
writes, or a heal recreates only some of the definitions and the rest stay missing while the
canary reports the batch healthy. It listed four of seven for a while — scouting-all,
assessment and analysis were added after the manifest and never added to it, so a wiped
platform would have come back with three Survey Definitions silently absent. Ordered
cheapest-first, with RepoFullSurvey last because it is the canary: it must not appear present
until every other document in the batch has run.
Documents here are generated by scripts/generate_repo_survey_definition.py from
../repo_survey_types.csv — edit the CSV and regenerate, don't hand-edit the markdown.

post_heal.reason: Link First/Next Process Step are not idempotent; strip duplicate step edges a heal may have created.
